Nifedipine Nifedipine

ATC G02CX · Substance ID nifedipine

Also called 也叫：心痛定、拜新同 nickname 俗称

Easily confused with：Nicardipine（Nicardipine niCARdipine） FDA recommends tall-man lettering for this pair; check the ingredient, not the name. All pairs
The same ingredient can carry completely different brand names in different countries, and the same name can point to a different ingredient. Listed by country — not interchangeable.
